mapper.select: SELECT id, underpass_id, level, risk_score_min, updated_by, updated_at FROM threshold WHERE underpass_id = #{underpassId} ORDER BY risk_score_min ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO threshold (underpass_id, level, risk_score_min, updated_by) VALUES (#{underpassId}, #{level}, #{riskScoreMin}, #{updatedBy})
INSERT INTO threshold_history (threshold_id, old_risk_score_min, new_risk_score_min, changed_by) VALUES (#{thresholdId}, #{oldRiskScoreMin}, #{newRiskScoreMin}, #{changedBy})
